title: How is Jesus connected to Roxy?
description:
A Renaissance fresco, 2,000 years of popes and eight real photos connect Jesus to Roxanne Wolf from Five Nights at Freddy's.

Jesus → Saint Peter → Pope Francis → Donald Trump → Bongbong Marcos → Vanessa Hudgens → Josh Hutcherson → Piper Rubio → Kellen Goff → Marta Svetek → Roxy

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
